name: כָּלַח
summary: Calah is a city built with Nineveh and Rehoboth-Ir; Resen lay between it and Nineveh. The verse gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The phrase וְאֶת כָּלַח identifies Calah as the last of the places built.

note: Moved from the former word entry `kkaala7`. The old root key כלח recorded the consonants of the place name. The verse gives no derivation.
